summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the implementation strategy for a script handling multiple categories. It was decided that the production (prod) version of the script will initially support only two categories: City and Moscow. For development/testing, the script will be run on staging with four categories, writing to a separate staging table.

[me] confirmed that raw data should be displayed for the non-release categories.
decisions: The production script will initially support only two categories (City and Moscow).
A staging environment setup will use four categories and write results to a dedicated staging table.
action_items: Someone will complete the initial script deployment today.
The switchover date for category scope will be determined on Monday.
